name: bi-capital-income-tax
description: Compute the verified part of an individual's Burundi capital-income and disposal-gain tax for calendar 2026. Use this Guide to classify nonbusiness investment receipts, distinguish private immovable gains from business-asset sales, select the statutory private-property holding-period coefficient, test the housing exemption and limit the land-registration-duty credit. It separates Treasury-interest relief from the secondary-market Treasury-gain exemption added in July. It also identifies the seller's disposal deadline and the separate payer and annual-return routes. Property reference values, financial-asset cost mechanics, professional-property interactions, relief execution and capital-return fields remain unresolved.
